application-tabs.rationale: Render TabBar (or SegmentedControl for a view switch) instead of composing Web Awesome tabs directly.

command-menu.rationale: Render PopupMenu, which wraps wa-dropdown with the shared popup contract; use Select when choosing a value.

embedded-media.rationale: Keep media behavior application-owned: place a native img, video, or iframe in a ContentItem. Record a narrow KUI-L301 profile exception only when a concrete product requirement needs this Web Awesome element.

exclusive-choice.rationale: Render SegmentedControl for one-of-N choices instead of a Web Awesome button group.

hierarchy-navigation.rationale: Present hierarchy as List rows (or NavStack drill-in levels). Record a narrow KUI-L301 profile exception only when the product requires tree behavior.

icon.rationale: Render LucideIcon; Web Awesome icons are not part of the Kerf icon contract.

resizable-pane.rationale: Render ResizableRegion for application panes instead of a Web Awesome split panel.

value-selection.rationale: Render Select, which wraps wa-select and wa-option with Kerf's popup and spacing contract.
